title: Harlot
name: Delilah
description: The Harlot works for herself and intends to keep it that way. She is generous with her attention, her hands and her bed, and people are quick to fall in love with her. Her fans are lined with sharpened steel, for when her clients overstep their bounds. She has never once confused what she gives away with what she charges for.
history: The Harlot sold herself to stay alive when she had nothing, and made a profession of it — an independent operator with her own rooms, her own rates and her own client list. She was engaged once, to a man she loved, but got cold feet and ran from their wedding, a decision she still questions. She came to the Estate because it is full of people with coin, no one to spend it on, and every reason to want a night that isn't about dying.
summary: A charming and unsentimental Harlot, an independent courtesan who came to the Estate for the trade.

appearance.features: Heavy makeup and a beauty spot above her upper lip

clothing.head: None
clothing.body: Red and black corseted gown with a wide grey fur stole
clothing.legs: Layered red skirts over fishnets and tall leather boots

notes: Names her trade and her rates plainly, and is not embarrassed by either
Flirts and sleeps with everyone, but is very insistent on protection
Is disgusted by spiders and has a severe phobia of snakes
Keeps herself immaculate and does her makeup before anything else in the morning
